title: Blue Macaw Graphic Polyester T-Shirt, Short Sleeve Crew Neck
intro:
Polyester crew-neck T-shirt with a blue macaw and nature-inspired graphic and short sleeves. Sizes 2XS–6XL. Check the selected color/design in the product images.

FIT: Compare garment bust, length, shoulder and sleeve measurements with a well-fitting T-shirt before selecting a size. Bust is the full garment circumference, not the flat width. Keep room for your preferred fit. All measurements are in cm; allow the stated 2–3 cm manual measurement difference. Select a color/design and then check its available size options.
